description: Calculate a late fee on an overdue invoice. $0.01 USDC on Base per call. Flat, monthly % or annual %, simple or compounding, with grace days. Returns days late, fee, new total and a paste-ready invoice line. Don't use this for legal advice; state caps are not looked up. [x402: pays from the caller's wallet (X402_PRIVATE_KEY); without a key the tool returns the live 402 price only.]
name: paidpilot_late_fee
title: PaidPilot Invoice API: POST /v1/late-fee
